hooks.name: scenario-from-brief
hooks.description: A new scenario brief becomes a validated scenario file plus its property test. This is how the kit grows new content. Agent action: uses credits.

action.prompt: A scenario brief was added. Read it and the scenario schema in packages/hindsight. Write the scenario file next to the other scenarios of that app, following every content rule in .kiro/steering/product.md (invented, no real institutions or procedures, none of the out-of-scope topics). Then add a property test asserting: it validates against the schema, every beat is reachable, the run always ends, every decision has at least two options, and for Dead Air every message fits in 64 bytes. Run that test and report the real result. If the brief asks for an out-of-scope topic, stop and say so instead of writing it.
